page.title: Identity Verification
page.subtitle: Verify your identity once to unlock investing, deposits and withdrawals on Capimax RT.
page.loadError: We couldn't load your verification status.

desc.not_started: You haven't started identity verification yet. It takes about 5 minutes.
desc.pending: Complete the remaining steps below and submit your verification.
desc.action_required: Our team asked you to update some documents. Replace them below and submit again.
desc.in_review: Your documents were submitted and our compliance team is reviewing them. This usually takes 24–48 hours.
desc.approved: Your identity is verified. You have full access to the platform.
desc.rejected: Your verification was not approved. Read the reason below, upload new documents and submit again.
desc.expired: Your verification has expired. Please verify your identity again.

steps.title: What you need to do
steps.complete_personal_info: Add your date of birth, nationality and country of residence
steps.upload_identity: Upload a government-issued ID (passport, national ID or driver's license)
steps.upload_selfie: Take a live selfie with your camera
steps.await_review: Wait for our team to review your documents (24–48 hours)

upload.dropHint: Drag and drop a file here, or tap to choose one
upload.locked: This document can't be changed while it is under review or already approved.
upload.invalidType: This file type isn't supported. Please upload {{formats}}.
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{size}}MB. Please upload a smaller file.

intro.title: Let's verify your identity
intro.desc: Regulations require us to confirm who you are before you can own property shares. Your data is encrypted and only used for verification.
intro.timeNote: It takes about 5 minutes. You'll need your ID and a device with a camera.
intro.needIdDesc: Passport, national ID or driver's license
intro.needSelfieDesc: Taken with your phone or computer camera
intro.needAddressDesc: Utility bill or bank statement from the last 3 months
intro.processing: Most verifications are reviewed within 24–48 hours. You'll get an email and a notification with the result.

personal.title: Personal information
personal.desc: This must match your identity document.
personal.dobHint: You must be at least 18 years old.
personal.privacy: Your personal information is encrypted and stored securely.

errors.dobUnderage: You must be at least 18 years old to use this platform
errors.dobFuture: Date of birth cannot be in the future
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your information. Please try again.

identity.title: Upload your ID document
identity.desc: Upload ONE of the following. Make sure the whole document is visible and readable.
identity.passportDesc: The photo page of your passport
identity.nationalIdDesc: Front side of your national ID card (include the back in the same image if possible)
identity.drivingDesc: Front side of your driver's license
identity.req2: All text is sharp and readable
identity.req3: No glare, shadows or fingers covering it
identity.req4: The document is valid and not expired

address.title: Proof of address (optional)
address.desc: You can skip this step. Adding it now speeds up higher ownership limits later.
address.utilityDesc: Electricity, water, gas or internet bill
address.bankDesc: Bank statement showing your name and address
address.req2: Shows your full name and address

selfie.title: Take a live selfie
selfie.desc: We compare your selfie with the photo on your ID to confirm it's really you.

review.title: Review and submit
review.desc: Check everything below, then submit your verification for review.
review.consent: By submitting, you confirm the information and documents are genuine and belong to you.

complete.title: Verification submitted
complete.desc: Thank you! Our compliance team is reviewing your documents.
complete.next2: You'll receive an email and a notification with the result
complete.next3: If anything needs fixing, we'll tell you exactly what to update

camera.tip1: Find a well-lit place and face the light
camera.tip2: Remove sunglasses, hats and face masks
camera.tip3: Hold the device at eye level and look at the camera
camera.requesting: Waiting for camera permission… Please tap "Allow" if your browser asks.
camera.liveTitle: Position your face inside the oval
camera.liveHint: Keep still and look straight at the camera.
camera.capturedHint: Make sure your whole face is visible, sharp and well lit.
camera.uploadedHint: Your selfie was uploaded. You can retake it until you submit.
camera.fallbackDesc: Take a selfie with your phone's camera app instead.

errors.permission: Camera access was blocked. Allow camera access in your browser settings (the camera icon in the address bar), then try again.
errors.notFound: No camera was found on this device. Use the button below to take a selfie with your phone instead.
errors.inUse: Your camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
errors.insecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) connection.
errors.unsupported: This browser doesn't support live camera capture. Use the button below instead.
errors.generic: We couldn't start your camera. Try again or take a selfie with your phone instead.
errors.noFrame: The camera image wasn't ready yet. Please try again.
errors.uploadFailed: Your selfie couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.

inReview.title: Your verification is under review
inReview.desc: You don't need to do anything right now. We'll email you as soon as the review is complete.

approved.title: You're verified
approved.desc: You can now own property shares, deposit and withdraw funds.

sumsub.title: Verify with our identity partner
sumsub.desc: Verification is handled securely by Sumsub. Follow the steps below; it takes about 5 minutes.
sumsub.error: The verification service couldn't be loaded. Please try again in a few minutes.
sumsub.submitted: Thank you — your verification was submitted. We'll update your status automatically.

errors.KYC_UNDER_REVIEW: Your verification is under review, so documents can't be changed right now. If our team needs anything, we'll ask you to update it.
errors.KYC_DOCUMENT_APPROVED: This document has already been approved and doesn't need to be replaced.
errors.KYC_INCOMPLETE: Your verification is not complete yet. Please finish the highlighted steps:
errors.SUMSUB_UNAVAILABLE: The verification service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

not_started.title: Verify your identity to start owning property
not_started.desc: Identity verification (KYC) is required before you can invest, deposit or withdraw. It takes about 5 minutes.

pending.title: Finish your identity verification
pending.desc: You started verification but haven't submitted it yet.

action_required.title: Action required on your verification
action_required.desc: Our team asked you to update some documents.

in_review.title: Your verification is under review
in_review.desc: We'll notify you by email once it's done (usually within 24–48 hours).

rejected.title: Your verification was not approved
rejected.desc: See the reason and resubmit your documents.

gate.title: Identity verification required
gate.desc: To {{action}}, you need to verify your identity first. This keeps your account secure and is required by financial regulations.
gate.pendingDesc: Your documents are being reviewed. You'll be able to {{action}} as soon as you're verified (usually within 24–48 hours).
gate.rejectedDesc: Your verification needs attention before you can {{action}}.

info.secureDesc: Your data is encrypted and handled according to financial-industry standards.
info.fastDesc: Most verifications are reviewed within 24–48 hours, with email updates.
info.supportDesc: Questions about verification? Our support team and AI assistant are here to help.
